scope: Durable request replay, expiry, opt-out and explicit resume
Owner controls, attribution, endorsement and receptionist lifecycle
Gateway and REST cancellation, publication evidence and reply routing
Joined-context create, update and delete ordering
confirmed_regressions_closed: Unsafe linked configuration, token and database files
Systemd path escaping and permanent startup retry exhaustion
Revision replay, expired or revoked reads, and resumed opt-out decisions
Uncancelled Gateway/REST work and reconnect after shutdown
Gateway resume URL, session-expiry recovery and frame-size handling
Duplicate acknowledgements and native submission after cancellation
Owner endorsement usable by the quoted source author
Picker replay submitting again after explicit resume
Expired bot reply silently selecting an unrelated worker
Delayed creates restoring deleted context and older edits overwriting newer edits

verification.external_effects: Local test servers and fake worker boundaries only; no production writes

limits: This is a scoped component approval, not a release or installation approval.
Live Discord and installed launchd/systemd reboot behavior were not exercised.
Native provider internals and the frozen repository-wide gates are reviewed separately.

follow_up_reviews.scope: Thread-only inheritance of explicitly configured parent-channel scope
